LanguageData.TotalFog_ResetDesc: Reset all settings to their defaults. Tree blocking stays as it is while a game is loaded.
LanguageData.MustBeUnderRoof: Must be placed under a roof.
LanguageData.MustBeNextToWall: Must be placed against a wall.
LanguageData.TotalFog_IntroAppearance: How explored ground looks when nobody is watching it.
LanguageData.TotalFog_IntroVision: Who sees for you, and how far.
LanguageData.TotalFog_IntroInformation: Which messages and details may tell you about things nobody has seen.
LanguageData.TotalFog_IntroAudio: Music and sounds can give away hidden events. Choose what you want to hear.
LanguageData.fogAlphaSetting_desc: How dark explored ground gets when nobody can see it right now.
LanguageData.fogFadeSpeedSetting_desc: How quickly the fog fades when sight changes. Off switches instantly.
LanguageData.baseViewRangeDesc: How far a colonist sees before health, light and weather are taken into account.
LanguageData.buildingVisionModDesc: Scales how far cameras and other buildings see. The placement preview does not change.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TurretVisionDesc: Scales how far automatic turrets see. A turret needs power or fuel to see at all.
LanguageData.TotalFog_AnimalVisionDesc: Scales how far your animals see. An animal needs a master and release training to see for you.
LanguageData.TotalFog_ColonyMechVisionDesc: Scales how far your mechs see. 1 keeps their normal range. Weapon range and hearing do not change.
LanguageData.allyGiveVision: Allies and visitors share their sight
LanguageData.TotalFog_AllyVisionDesc: Friendly people and animals on your map let you see what they see, at half their normal range.
LanguageData.TotalFog_PrisonerVisionDesc: Your prisoners let you see what they see, at one fifth of their normal range.
LanguageData.TotalFog_MapRevealDesc: New maps begin with all ground explored. You still only see what your colonists see right now.
LanguageData.treesBlockSightDesc: Grown trees block the line of sight. Saplings and stumps do not.
LanguageData.treesBlockSight_RequiresReload: Change this from the main menu, then load your game.
LanguageData.onlyOutsideColonyDesc: Your home maps show everything. Fog stays on all other maps.
LanguageData.clearFogDuringTargeting: Full map view during gravship flights
LanguageData.clearFogDuringTargetingDesc: Shows the whole map while you choose a landing site and during takeoff and landing. This can show you things nobody has seen.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerVisionDesc: How much farther a lookout sees from the top of a watchtower. Roofs, mountains and other towers still block the view.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerRangeDesc: A lookout never sees farther than this many cells.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerClimbDesc: How long climbing up or down takes. 60 ticks are one second of game time.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerShootingDesc: Lookouts can shoot over freestanding walls. Up there they are easier to hit and cannot fight in melee.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TelescopeRangeDesc: A colonist at a watch telescope never sees farther than this many cells. Independent of watchtowers.
LanguageData.delayAlertsUntilSeenDesc: Letters and messages about something nobody can see wait until someone sees it. Colony health and world events still arrive at once.
LanguageData.TotalFog_DiscardEventsDesc: Letters and messages of the chosen kinds are dropped while nobody can see what they are about. Colony health, visible events and world events still arrive. Use “Delayed news” above to keep them instead.
LanguageData.TotalFog_SilentRaidsDesc: No letter and no slowdown when raids or manhunter packs arrive, even in plain sight. They still attack, and combat still slows time. Music is a separate setting.
LanguageData.wildLifeTabVisibleDesc: The Wildlife tab also lists animals nobody can see. This gives away that they are there.
LanguageData.hideSpeakBubbleDesc: Hides Interaction Bubbles of characters out of sight.
LanguageData.aiSmartDesc: Human enemies can only target what their own side can see. A colonist in the dark stays hidden.
LanguageData.TotalFog_InteractWithRememberedObjectsDe: Select, inspect and give orders to buildings and items you have seen before, as long as they are still where you saw them. This includes right-click work orders. People, animals, combat targets and anything never seen still need current sight. Your own colonists and construction plans always work.
LanguageData.NeedWatcherDesc: Cameras only show their surroundings while a colonist works at a camera console.
LanguageData.TotalFog_SuppressCombatMusicDesc: Keeps the normal music playing during combat and Anomaly events, so a change of music cannot warn you.
LanguageData.TotalFog_MuteHiddenSoundsDesc: Sounds from things nobody can see are silent, including ongoing loops. This overrides hearing-based filtering.
LanguageData.TotalFog_FilterHiddenSoundsDesc: Hidden sounds are muffled and only play near a living colonist who could hear them. Beyond hearing range they are silent.
LanguageData.audioSourceRangeDesc: How many cells away a colonist can still hear a hidden sound.
LanguageData.volumeMufflingModifierDesc: How much quieter a hidden sound gets toward the edge of hearing range.
LanguageData.TotalFog_ShowHearingCuesDesc: Small marks show where a colonist hears hidden movement. Turn this off to remove them.
LanguageData.TotalFog_HearingRangeDesc: How many cells away hidden movement can be heard.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerHoldingDrafted: Keeping watch until undrafted or ordered away
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerBlockedLadder: The cell in front of the ladder must stay clear.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerEmptyFirst: Bring the lookout down before deconstructing the tower.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerExitBlocked: The ladder is blocked. Clear the cell in front of it so the lookout can climb down.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerWaitingForExit: Waiting for the ladder of {0} to clear.
LanguageData.TotalFog_TowerEmergencyExit: {0} jumps off the blocked watchtower. The fall may hurt.
